name: Walter Reed Bethesda tower
elevationDatum: Local rigid exterior footing plane y=0; real metres, +X east, +Y up, +Z south. Mapped rotation is baked once; no DEM, sea-level or Mercator scale.
note: This is the Bethesda historic tower and original PresidentZone base block, not the former WalterReedArmyMedicalCenter inWashington. The footprint supplies the projecting west entrance/tower stem, two L-shaped pavilions and low eastconnector. The tower’s higher masses are fitted within those mapped controls; their subdivisions are photo estimates. The1977NationalRegister description identifies a20storey tower and3/4storey pavilions; CTBUH gives19floors, while earlier accounts use other counts. This model records the disagreement and does not claim a surveyed floor schedule.264ft(80.4672m) is the officialcampusmasterplanheight. Bronze sash/serpentine spandrels are separated into lighter horizontal floor bands against offwhite quartz/concrete, as described in the register and confirmed by currentpost2011exteriorphotos1/3. Photo2 is a widercampuscontext view. New hospitalconstruction, detached modernmedicalblocks, roads, forecourt, flags, seals and lettering are omitted. All feet at a single localrigid y0; no terrainbaked. Source readiness does not establish RockvillePike or campusgrade fitting in eitherappmode. Cityscape: not tested. Full 3D world: not tested. Review follow-up: Lightened floor spandrels to #adaf9f daylight / #879da7 dark. Main shaft bays retain 13 separate rows and the front stem 14 rows in both LODs; separators are at least 0.6 m tall and over 40/255 grayscale lighter than glass. The white piers, front projection and stepped crown retain their dimensions.
